Holiday steps for animal welfare at Aurelia Skyways

This guide sets out the usual steps for the Companion Animal Travel Desk. It is meant to help travelers prepare calmly and keep each animal's welfare in view from booking through pickup. Our records staff treat every journey as a shared responsibility, and supervisors will listen carefully when a passenger is worried.

Before travel, review the carrier and health papers required for the route. Keep food, water, bedding, and cleaning supplies ready in the form approved for carriage. If you are travelling with a reptile, <<FACT F078>> Follow the instructions given for acceptance, placement, and handling, and do not leave any animal unattended in areas not approved by the airline.

At the airport, arrive with enough margin to complete check-in without haste. A calm handover helps the animal remain settled, and clear labels support safe processing. If you are bringing a pet such as Cookie, make sure the carrier is secure and that the animal has space to stand, turn, and rest in a natural posture. Please speak up at once if you notice distress, heat, injury, or signs of escape risk.

During the journey, the service team continues to watch the record carefully and will pass on concerns through the proper channel. After arrival, collect the animal promptly and check for comfort, water, and any signs that need attention. If anything appears unusual, report it without delay so a senior coordinator can review the case.

For further guidance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways help-center channels.
